evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 800 EUR
THI charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester (for Bachelor’s programmes).
Application period for the winter semester 2027/28: April 1 to July 15, 2027

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 800 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants, matching the THI-wide figure for third-country Bachelor students; no separate programme-specific fee is given. Intakes: only the winter semester 2027/28 application period (April 1 to July 15, 2027) is stated in full; the DAAD page gives a generic 1 April - 15 July window without a year, and the programme starts in the winter semester only. Application channel: the VPD from uni-assist is mandatory for foreign higher-secondary certificates, and the PRIMUSS portal is used afterwards; the university states international applicants should apply directly via the uni-assist application portal. Documents: the pages do not name a document list for this programme (only that VPD requires certified documents and language certificates need not go to uni-assist), so no documents fact is given.

note.fr: Admission requires a recognised university entrance qualification (secondary school certificate). Selection also includes a curriculum analysis and a selection interview; a SAT score of at least 1000 may earn bonus points.
note.en: Admission requires a recognised university entrance qualification (secondary school certificate). Selection also includes a curriculum analysis and a selection interview; a SAT score of at least 1000 may earn bonus points.

evidence.quote: Admission requires a recognised university entrance qualification (secondary school certificate) and sufficient proficiency in English.
Applicants who have achieved a total score of 70 points or more will be invited to a short online selection interview.
